summary: Short kerb beside houses 14-16 m away; park opposite, steep and tight.
reasons: Houses 14 and 16 m on same side
Cars park here; park across road

drivers.seclusion: Two houses 14 and 16 m on the section's own side; park and trees on the far side.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside trees and a narrow verge; cars park here, so a van fits about one length.
drivers.traffic: Collector-type street with moderate traffic; cars park both sides.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs; parked cars along both kerbs.

sun_shade: Large trees shade the south end; the east side is open to morning sun.

best_section.where: West kerb of Moorak Street, opposite the grassy park
